title: Cross-review ledger
description: Provider-neutral record of who mutated, who reviewed, whether the review was read-only, and whether it can count as independent Layer 2 under current policy. A record, not an independence guarantee: it can reject a false independence claim and a false completion claim, and it grants no authority to commit, push, open a pull request, merge, deploy, or promote anything.

evidence_reference.description: A structured pointer to retained evidence. The pattern is deliberately identical to schemas/executor-evidence.schema.json#/$defs/evidence_reference — one reference format across contracts, asserted by a conformance scenario so the two cannot drift. A reference is validated as a string and never dereferenced: no validator fetches, opens, executes, replays, or proves the existence of what it points at.

optional_evidence_reference.description: An evidence reference, or null where the thing referenced honestly does not exist yet.

tool.description: Public tool identity. Never a private model name or a private route name. 'other' means unrecorded or unrecognised, which is not the same as distinct.

provider.description: Public provider identity. Never a private model name. 'other' means unrecorded or unrecognised, which is not the same as distinct.

role.description: What the review was for. String enum. Never a boolean.

severity.description: String enum. Never a boolean. A blocker blocks the whole record; there is no resolution field, because no resolution machinery exists in this version.

identity.description: Who ran. Adapter is optional context and is never an identity by itself.

review.description: One recorded review. The three same_*_as_executor booleans are redundant against the recorded identities on purpose: they are attestations, and the validator recomputes them and rejects contradictions. A contradiction is evidence of a bad record, not something to reconcile silently — which is why they must not later be 'simplified' away.

subject.description: What was reviewed, by reference. Every field here is a validated reference string only; the ledger records that a claim was made, never that the referenced artifact exists.

executor.description: The one mutator for this unit.

adapter_internal_verification.description: Verification an adapter ran on its own work. Useful evidence; never independent Layer 2. Represented explicitly even when absent, so 'no adapter check ran' and 'nobody recorded whether one ran' are different records.

counts_as_independent_layer2.description: Always false. Adapter-local verification of adapter-local work is not an independent review.

independent_review_id.description: Required key. Names the single review claimed as independent, or null. Multiple auxiliary reviews never aggregate into an independent one.

auto_promotion_allowed_by_this_record.description: Always false. This ledger never arms auto-merge.

behavior_check.description: The human behavior check stays outside this ledger. A missing one is recorded honestly, never as completion.

promotion.description: What this record says about promotion, which is only ever 'blocked' or 'not blocked by me'. Never 'authorized'.

blocked_by_this_record.description: false means only that this ledger recorded no promotion-blocking review finding. It never means promotion is authorized.

authorized_by_this_record.description: Always false. Review evidence may add reasons to reject; it may never be the reason to merge.
